entities.summary: Dominic Akuritinga Ayine is a Ghanaian politician and a member of the Sixth, Seventh, Eighth, and Ninth Parliaments of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Bolgatanga East Constituency in the Upper East Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress.
